items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I went into Dallas and got to talking to Bernie one time and he said, Ernie, I think I have about fourteen pieces in the band... and so I came back and started talking around... we got in and 808.

ctx.x: I am the charter member of the Tulsa black local when we had to have it, and so what I did I joined 168 in Dallas, Texas; Bernie Johnson was secretary then and went on for several years, and then when it came this ten percent tax, that was a big headache, if you were out of that jurisdiction, you had to pay that ten percent tax.
So I would come home and go play and there was Danny Fox--he was the secretary of ninety four.
